payload.summary: Two unrouted Pipeline-A signal types now sit in pending_triage_inbox[]: sprint_registry_dangling_ids (pre-existing) and recurring-bug (introduced by this tick, 2 rows). Routing rows live in agent-father's exclusive zone, so dev-team cannot add them.
payload.owner_zone_note: docs/agents/** is agent-father's exclusive zone. Route the table edit there; dev-team and the router must not write it.
payload.self_reported: The 2 recurring-bug rows were emitted by THIS dev-team tick (2026-08-23T15:37Z) while reporting two genuine Step 0a findings. Verified at source that recurring-bug was absent from the inbox at commit 0c9380859 (the SHA CI tested) and present afterwards -- so the next CI run will report BOTH types, and the second one is self-inflicted. Recording it rather than letting it look pre-existing.
payload.root_cause_of_the_self_inflicted_half: docs/agents/dev-team/flow/main.md's HEAD.lock-recurrence example hands the author a ready-made signal envelope using type 'recurring-bug'. That literal appears ZERO times in either docs/agents/po/flow/triage-signals.md or triage-signals-longtail.md, so the flow doc's own copy-paste template emits a type the Pipeline-A guard treats as unrouted. Any agent following that example reds signal-type-coverage-guard. This is a template defect, not a one-off author error -- it will recur for every future reader of that section.
payload.requested_fix: Add Pipeline-A routing rows for sprint_registry_dangling_ids and recurring-bug, AND correct the dev-team flow doc's HEAD.lock example to template a routed type (or add recurring-bug to the table so the example becomes valid). Fixing only the table leaves the template correct-by-accident; fixing only the doc leaves the 2 live rows unrouted.
payload.guard_caution: Do NOT invoke scripts/audits/guard-signal-type-coverage.sh to verify: it is not read-only (writes live orch-state.json via ORCH_APPLY_LIVE_FILE_OVERRIDE) and its documented --check flag is a no-op alias, not a dry-run. Verify by grepping the Pipeline-A table for the type instead.
